lines.en: My fur is stiff as wood chips
I walk into the woods over fallen leaves
Thin twigs sprout from my back
Shoots rise in my footprints
I circle an old tree
My paws sink into rotting leaves
Bark-like plates hug my ribs
I move along the treeline
Mist rises where I pass
My tail drags across moss
The light I see has gone green
I head deeper into the trees
I slip between the roots
I crush dry leaves underfoot
I follow a forest trail
I move slowly through the mist
I stand like a cut stump
Insects crawl in my fur
My ears are two leaves
When I blink, the shadows move
I listen to the forest breathe
Bark is stuck between my teeth
The charm on me glows faint
I crouch and sniff the soil
My shadow is the wrong shape
I sit without wagging
I look up at the canopy
Wind passes through me like branches
I turn once and stop
I can smell many years ago
I plant my claws in the earth
I look at your shadow first
You carry the smell of iron
I tilt my head to hear you
My green eyes rest on you
Your steps unsettle me
I shift half a step forward
You stand inside my treeline

lines.zh: 迷咒缠着我，我连自己都认不出。
lines.en: Bewitched, I barely know myself.
My ears have turned to you
Do not touch that tree
I am waiting on your move
One of my twigs snaps
I let out a low whine
I give half a step and hold
A tuft of my fur falls out
My charm flickers
My shadow warps further
You broke my stride
The curse burns in my blood; I don't back off.
What fruit is that you hold
I sniff it, it is nearly ripe
I do not quite trust your hand
I edge closer slowly
You set it on the ground
I hesitate for a moment
I lower my head and bite once
It tastes faintly of wood
I eat it and cannot say why
Those are wild berries, yes
You open your hand with fruit
Just a little closer
You hit my ribs
We both step back
My twigs snag on you
Your sleeve is torn by bark
Something in me sounds like breaking wood
I turn to face you
The impact startles a flock of birds
I shake the leaves off
I nudge you back half a step
There is another in these woods
I hear an answer far off
We watch each other through the mist
My kind carry the same charm
We walk a stretch together
Her coat is greener than mine
The forest speaks for us
We keep the same ground
She slips back into the shadows
I pick up a dead branch
I pick up a pine cone
It breaks in my teeth
I carry it back to my den
I dig up a root
This thing smells of old times
I bury it under the leaves
I carry a stone aside
I leave it by the roots
A stranger is in the woods
I lower my head
The smell you brought is wrong
My back fur stands up
I step toward you
You are standing under my tree
I fix on your hands
You broke a path I knew
There is only you that way
You need to get out of these woods
I follow you around the trunks
I hear your boots
The mist hides my shadow
I do not bark, I follow

lines.zh: 你进的那片林子是我的
lines.en: The woods you entered are mine
I step in your prints
My paws make almost no sound
You must cross my treeline sometime
I see your torch
I keep to the trees behind you

lines.zh: 我的爪子撕开你的袖子
lines.en: My claws tear your sleeve
My teeth sink into your boot
A branch of me rakes your face
I bite and pull back
I knock you into the leaves
My paw pins your hand
I growl low in my chest

lines.zh: 这一下带着林子的力气
lines.en: That blow carried the forest's weight
Two green eyes open in the mist

lines.zh: 树皮上的符纹跟着我一起亮。
lines.en: The runes on the bark light up as I walk past.
A dead tree shivers once
The leaves gather by themselves
I land on the roots
A new shadow joins the woods
The charm on me lights up
I shake the moss off
My shape takes form in the mist
The wind blows the leaves my way
Fire curls my fur

lines.zh: 我落地时压断了一根枝
lines.en: I land and snap a branch

lines.zh: 水泡胀了我身上的木头
lines.en: Water swells the wood in me
The blast sweeps the leaves away

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的树皮甲
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my bark plate

lines.zh: 咒光让我身上的符嗡嗡响
lines.en: Magic makes my charm hum
Hunger makes my steps unsteady

lines.zh: 雷电顺着我身上的枝走
lines.en: Lightning runs along my twigs

lines.zh: 坠落时我身上的叶子落光
lines.en: My leaves all fall as I drop
